purpose: Compare repeated region, repeated decision, and paired multitask SFT with matched source exposures
source_order: One shared random.Random(42), sequential shuffle of a fresh original 768-source list for each of two epochs; identical exposure sequence in all arms
mixed_task_assignment: Within each category/label group of 32, fixed seeded shuffle assigns 16 region and 16 decision in epoch1; epoch2 reverses every source task
training_initialization: Every arm starts from the same fresh quantized base plus freshly initialized LoRA; no adapter field and no previous checkpoint initialization
model_selection: Fixed final update192; validation CE is diagnostic only, never checkpoint selection by test/confirmation results

validation.sources: Existing fixed 120 validation sources, paired region and decision prompts, original order preserved
validation.ce_audit: steps64/128/192, fixed first24; region_region and region_decision use region prompts, decision_decision uses decision prompts
validation.ce_comparability: Different target tasks have different lengths and difficulty; CE across task prompts is not a common decision metric
validation.generation_protocol: Five main evaluations on the same fixed120 validation sources using final192 adapters: region_region under region and decision prompts, region_decision under region and decision prompts, decision_decision under decision prompt
validation.primary_comparison: Test region_decision versus region_region for common decision-prompt performance, within-adapter prompt decision consistency, and region-prompt localization tradeoff; no improvement is assumed
validation.decision_decision_region_prompt: Not a main comparison; the decision-only target arm is evaluated primarily with its decision prompt

confirmation.selection: Metadata-only category/label sampling from original test split after excluding every previous evaluated source/hash and all train/val sources/hashes
confirmation.policy: Do not generate/read confirmation outputs this round. Use only after protocol/model selection is frozen in a later final evaluation

matched: image pixel and text length limits
fairness.loss: Existing assistant-only CE is normalized by actual supervised tokens per accumulated update; region answers can therefore contribute more tokens than decision answers in the mixed arm
fairness.report: Record actual supervised/input token counts, GPU memory, wall time; double-budget v2 versus96-update v1 is descriptive and not a causal multitask control

limits: source SHA256 isolation does not prove physical-part or near-duplicate independence
public benchmark pretraining contamination is unknown
union rectangle localization, not instance/pixel segmentation
